//: Single source of truth for the capability-probe script (scripts/preflight.sh) and the per-platform generator (harness-gen). Edit this file, not their output. See AGENTS.md.

project.name: Harbour
project.//name: Display name shown to an agent/operator. This is the template's own demo brand (see artifacts/web/content/settings/footer.yml). An adopter forking this template for a real client replaces it with the client's name.

site.//host: Placeholder — replace with the deployed origin and set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to match (see .env.example at the repo root). Left unset/unreplaced, artifacts/web/src/app/sitemap.ts silently falls back to this same placeholder and ships a sitemap of example.com URLs.

commands.//check: Exact order CI runs them in (.github/workflows/ci.yml), harness:check first. All must pass — the build is the gate.

capabilities.label: Newsletter Block form submissions post to a Slack channel
capabilities.fallback: -> Point the Newsletter Block's `action` prop (artifacts/web/src/lib/blocks/schemas.ts, artifacts/web/src/components/blocks/newsletter.tsx) at a different form endpoint you do control (e.g. Formspree, a serverless function), or leave `action` as a placeholder URL until a real endpoint is configured. The Block itself has no server code — `action` is a plain literal URL prop, so any safe-scheme endpoint works.

capabilities.label: Image uploads to Vercel Blob storage
capabilities.fallback: -> Reference existing images by URL instead of uploading new ones: images.unsplash.com, assets.ui.sh, or a file already committed under artifacts/web/public/ (served as a relative /path). These are the only hosts artifacts/web/next.config.mjs's images.remotePatterns allows besides *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com, and mediaSrc() in schemas.ts enforces the same list at build time.
